seriesTitle: Berlin and the Jewels of Paris

episodes.title: La energía del amor
episodes.summary: During his glory days, Berlin assembles a gang in Paris for an almost impossible heist for 44 million euros' worth of jewels from 34 cities in one night.

episodes.title: El ancla y el lobo
episodes.summary: Roi and Cameron must stop Father Toureaux as he threatens to bungle the plan. Meanwhile, love is in the air on Paris's streets — and in the Catacombs.

episodes.title: Póker de embriones
episodes.summary: Everything seems to be rolling along — for a short while. While Berlin schemes to get his way with both the heist and Camille, Damián gets some bad news.

episodes.title: Un aquarium en la espalda
episodes.summary: The robbery is on and tensions are high as the crew starts to doubt Berlin's leadership. Keila and Bruce must make sure to cover their tracks.

episodes.title: After Love
episodes.summary: Cameron's resurfaced trauma bursts in at an illegal street race. The plan enters a new phase as the gang flees the police, who are hot on their heels.

episodes.title: La noche de los limones
episodes.summary: Camille's suspicions heighten. Damián, Cameron and Roi have a troubling encounter, shaking the entire gang's alibis. A loose end emerges in Paris.

episodes.title: La última virgen de occidente
episodes.summary: As Bruce helps Keila with a life-or-death situation, Sierra and Murillo join the French police to look into the theft. Berlin suffers an ultimate defeat.

episodes.title: Un elefante en peligro de extinción
episodes.summary: Backed into a corner, the gang maneuvers a final escape plan. Only time will tell if Berlin is ready for the ultimate bombshell.
